requirements.general: Entry Requirements Applicants must meet any of the following: Pass SPM/O-Level (or equivalent) with a minimum of Grade C in at least three (3) subjects; Pass UEC with a minimum of Grade B in at least three (3) subjects; Pass STPM (or equivalent) with a minimum of Grade C (GP 2.00) in at least one (1) subject; Pass STAM with Grade Maqbul (Pass); Recognised Creative Multimedia Certificate or its equivalent; Recognised related Technical and Vocational Certificate or its equivalent with one (1) year relevant work experience or completion of one (1) trimester bridging programme; Pass SKM Level 3 or any qualifications equivalent to Certificate (Level 3, MQF) in a related field; Possess an APEL.A certificate from MQA for admission into Diploma programmes; AND Pass an interview OR submit a student’s portfolio, as determined by MMU.
